prior_finding_lineage.finding: The first sentence does not identify the three-turn FIREBURN damage consistently, and the empowered burst clause omits that all affected targets are burned and stunned.
prior_finding_lineage.host_disposition: confirmed pre-existing advisory queued for this separate bounded batch

before.source:
The power of the Fearscape infuses your weapon: Your melee attacks will deal %0.2f fire damage, spread over 3 turns.
		Additionally, every time you attack, there is a %d%% chance of releasing a burst of powerful fire that will deal %0.2f fire damage to all enemies in radius %d over %d turns.
		If this talent is not on cooldown, the burst of fire will instead be radius %d, and stun all targets in addition to burning them.
		For the purposes of applying the stun, you have %d bonus spellpower.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
before.target:
恶魔空间的力量注入你的武器：你的近战攻击在 3 回合内造成 %0.2f 点火焰伤害。
	另外，每次攻击时有 %d%% 几率造成 %0.2f 火焰燃烧伤害， %d 码内的所有敌人都会受到此伤害，燃烧持续 %d 回合。
	若该技能冷却完毕，则火焰爆发将聚集在 %d 码范围内，并产生火焰震慑效果。
	进行震慑判定时，额外增加 %d 点法术强度。
	伤害受法术强度加成。

	另外，每次攻击时有 %d%% 几率释放强力火焰爆发，造成总计 %0.2f 点火焰燃烧伤害；半径 %d 内的所有敌人都会受到此伤害，持续 %d 回合。

	伤害受法术强度加成。

source_resolution.host_disposition: all four bounded questions confirmed after independent source recheck

answers.question: Which damage type and duration does the melee-hit proc use?
answers.answer: DamageType.FIREBURN with its default duration of three turns; the displayed damage is the complete event total, not a per-turn amount.

answers.question: Which damage type, duration, radius and recipient filter does the ordinary burst use?
answers.answer: DamageType.FIREBURN with t.getDur(self,t)=3, self:getTalentRadius(t), and friendlyfire=false, so only hostile/enemy actors reach the projector.

answers.question: When the talent is off cooldown, which damage type is projected and do all affected hostile targets receive both burning and stun?
answers.answer: DamageType.FLAMESHOCK is projected with t.getStunRad(self,t), friendlyfire=false and the same three-turn duration. Every hostile target on which EFF_BURNING_SHOCK is successfully applied is both burned and stunned.

answers.question: Does the info placeholder order remain damage, chance, burst damage, ordinary radius, duration, empowered radius and bonus spellpower?
answers.answer: Yes; the seven values occur in exactly that order.

source_provenance.ashes_source_status: The snapshot identity is frozen, but the inspected public Ashes repository, commit, version and source revision are not fixed by the manifest. The observed Ashes file hash is an unpinned source anchor.

facts: The melee proc and ordinary burst pass their displayed damage values through FIREBURN.
The ordinary burst uses its talent radius, duration 3 and friendlyfire=false.
The empowered burst uses the displayed stun radius, FLAMESHOCK, duration 3, friendlyfire=false and temporary bonus spellpower.
The info values are melee damage, chance, burst damage, ordinary radius, duration, empowered radius and bonus spellpower in that order.
FIREBURN consumes its damage argument as the total event damage and distributes its burning portion over the supplied duration.
FLAMESHOCK applies EFF_BURNING_SHOCK when the target does not resist stun.

anchors.fact: The successfully applied effect carries fire and stun subtypes and supplies both periodic fire damage and stun behavior for its duration.
With friendlyfire=false, reaction-nonnegative actors do not reach the projection callback.
